description: The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a dual-monitor configuration (monitors 1 and 2|3) with options for multiple displays, brightness, night light, HDR, scale, and resolution settings visible.
Windows 11 Settings app showing Display settings with a "Keep these display settings?" confirmation dialog asking the user to confirm or revert display resolution changes within 8 seconds.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing display configuration options including brightness, scale (100%), resolution (2560 × 1440), and orientation settings for a single monitor.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a multi-monitor configuration with 3 displays (display 1 as main, displays 2 and 3 duplicated) and various display settings including brightness, night light, HDR, scale (100%), and resolution (2560 x 1440).

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration (displays 1, 2|3) with options for brightness, night light, HDR, scale (100%), resolution (2560 × 1440), and orientation settings visible.
